div.l: Verily at the first Chaos came to be, but next wide-bosomed Earth, the ever-sure foundation of all
the deathless ones, and Eros (Love), fairest among the deathless gods.
From Chaos came forth Erebus and black Night; but of Night were born Aether and Day,
And Earth first bare starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side.Or "Sky". And she brought forth long hills.
But Rhea was subject in love to Cronos and bare splendid children, Hestia, Demeter, and gold-shod Hera and strong Hades,
